answer: Fingerprint each operator's camera by its sensor noise, the faint PRNU pattern every image chip leaves in its photos. At sign-up the operator shoots a paper card mixed in the pigment colors named by that epoch's public random beacon, plus any outdoor scene, such as a river bank. Both shots must share one noise signature, and one signature unlocks one agent. Clones cannot reuse a sensor, so a farm of 300 fakes needs about 300 used phones at $60 each, roughly $18,000.
